dataList.content:
The weather there is quite hostile.
那边的天气相当糟糕。

Meursault was right. The Lake beyond the borders was nigh pitch-black. The waves crested tall, rising and crashing violently under the thundering rainstorm.
正如默尔索所言，能看见边界另一侧的空间漆黑一片。在雷鸣般咆哮的暴雨中，巨浪猛烈地起伏和拍击。

Mm... The wild winds have begun to sway the boat...
嗯……风浪已经开始撼动船身了……

Yi Sang's face was starting to grow pale.
李箱的表情开始变得苍白起来。

I'm starting to wonder if we can... really do this.
我们……真的能做到吗？

Did we ever let that stop us from trying?
什么时候我们是因为确定能够做到才去做的呢。

Ha, I guess that's true~
哈，说得也是呢~

... All right. Heading into the zone.
……我们要穿越这条边界了。

Are there any laws of that Lake that we must be mindful of?
我们不用担心这片湖域的浪潮吗？

I don't know the laws of that Lake, nor its Waves.
我也不知道前方这片湖域的规则和浪潮的种类。

I remember the way the fog split open. I remember the obsidian sea and the endless tempest.
海雾洞开的模样，还有其中那波澜起伏的漆黑湖面，仍留在我的记忆之中……

But the rest of it... All I remember is that the Captain was excitedly delivering a speech at witnessing the legends come to life, and that we were all busy preparing for the Whale hunt.
我只记得亲眼目睹传说真实存在的船长所发表的激动的演说，以及我们忙上忙下为捕鲸做着准备的样子。

... So, what awaits us ahead is a real adventure. We'll be sailing blindly into the night.
……所以，接下来可是一场真正的冒险。

... Gulp.
……咕噜。

Then... we'll have to face everything head-on.
此后……我们必须直面前方的一切。

Yes. If the Waves come to claim us, we will face them. Head-on.
是的。如果浪潮来袭，我们将直面它们。

... Even the Whale.
……即使出现的是那头鲸。

... No signs of that Whale yet, though.
……到目前为止，一切都很平静。

Back then, it attacked us mere minutes after we entered the Lake.
那时，我们进入这片湖域还没有几分钟，它就发起了袭击。

Everyone was as tense as they could ever be, looking around nervously...
当每个人都极度紧张地环顾四周时……

Wait, what's... that? There's something there, something tall.
等等……那是什么？好像有什么很长……还很高的东西在那里。

A close approach is recommended. I have a source of light to improve our visibility.
建议靠近观察。我会站起来，用光源来提高我们的能见度。

Meursault got up with a lantern and pointed the light toward where Sinclair indicated.
默尔索提着提灯站起身来，将灯光照向辛克莱所指的地方。

There's... several of them...?
那边不只有一只……？

What's that...? Hell, who put 'em there? What are they even for?
那是什么……那种玩意儿有必要漂浮在大湖中间吗？

Maybe they're like lighthouses...?
也许它们起到类似灯塔的作用……？

Lighthouses? Yeah, I can kinda see that...
灯塔吗，看起来好像确实如此……

<Do you remember seeing anything like that, Ishmael?>
<以实玛利，你有记得见过类似的东西吗？>

No... I don't even have a hazy recollection of it. I've never seen it before in my...
没有……我不仅是没有模糊的印象，而且是从来没见过这样的东西……

I-Ishmael. Has the nausea of the swaying sea gotten to you as well?
以、以实玛利女士。你也突然晕船了吗？

Your face has grown rather pale...
你的脸色……变得非常苍白。

I knew that that can't be true.
我知道那是不可能的。

A seasick sailor only exists in jokes. Besides, Ishmael was doing just fine mere moments ago.
水手会晕船这种事本身就够离谱了，对于一直以来都十分镇定的以实玛利来说就更不可能了。

Then... she must've had a sudden realization.
因此，这只能说明她突然意识到了什么。

I see... So that's what it looked like. Even a small part of it is...
我明白了……原来它是这样子的啊。即使这只是它很小的一部分……

A terrifying realization.
而且，她意识到的应该是一件相当具有冲击性的事实吧。

W-what is it?
那、那是什么东西？

You'll find out soon enough. Even if you don't want to.
……即使你不想知道，也很快就会知道的。

There, a rogue wave ahead...!
那是，海啸吗……！

All hands, brace! Grab onto what you can!
所有人，抓紧一切可以抓住的东西！

A-ah! Agh...!
啊、啊！咕啊……

Before we even had the chance to say anything, a leviathan of a wave rose to its crest, then crashed onto us from above...
我们甚至都没来得及说什么，一阵滔天巨浪就淹没了小船……

And sucked us deep into the Lake before throwing us back to the surface.
我们暂时被水面淹没，一段时间后又浮了上来。

Pah...!
噗啊……！

... We were lucky. There was a high chance that the following vortex would have dragged the vessel deep underwater.
……我们很幸运。刚才它沉没的可能性更大。

L-lucky? You saw what was down there, that was...
不是……我们真的是运气好吗？刚才……

<... Everyone okay?>
<……大家都没事吧？>

Everyone was soaking wet, nearly hyperventilating, but... mostly awestruck by what we've just witnessed.
所有人都浑身湿透，几乎喘不过气来，但……都被我们刚刚所目睹的一切所震惊。

We have everyone, but...
没人掉队，但……

Huh? Huh...? What we just saw down there... were...
哈？哈？刚刚……我们看到的是……

They weren't lighthouses... They were...
它们并非是灯塔……而全都是……

Tails of colossal Whales...!
巨大无比的鲸之尾。

Wow... Okay... I really wanna give up now, ha ha.
哇哦……我真的……有点想现在放弃了？哈哈。

I wanna go back to the time when I didn't know what the Whales really looked like...
我好想回到自己还不知道鲸长什么模样的时候……

So this is the Lake where the Whales come to sleep...
所以这片湖域是鲸群的沉眠之地……

Yeah. If they're deep in the water with their necks bent like that... I could see their tails rising tall over the surface.
是的，如果它们睡觉的时候脖子像那样弯着……尾巴就会高高翘起，露出水面……

But... There's no way they missed this commotion.
但……它们不可能会忽视掉这么大的动静。

T-t-t-the ship is... We're... we're keeling over!
……船、船、船……船在倾斜！

... The Whales are waking up.
……现在鲸们要苏醒了。

'We're finally here.'
“我们终于走到这一步了。”

... I think that's what Ishmael whispered. But the storm, the waves buried her voice deep into the Lake.
我想以实玛利小声嘟囔的内容大致如此，但暴雨和浪潮的呼啸已将她的声音淹没其中。

If the Indigo Elder made it here as we planned...
如果靛蓝老人能够按计划平安到达任务地点……

WOAAAAAAHHHHH!
哇啊啊啊啊啊！！

OVER YONDER, I-IS THAT THE WHALE?!
那、那就是鲸吗！

We didn't have to wonder even for a second about what Don Quixote was screaming at.
我们根本没有对堂吉诃德尖叫的原因产生丝毫疑惑的必要。

An entire herd of entities, each dwarfing every single Whale we've weathered throughout this journey, emerged from the waters all at once. In unison, they began migrating in a singular direction. To witness something like that was...
那是迄今为止见过的个体无法争锋的巨大存在。在同一时间露出水面，一致地向某个方向游去的鲸群的姿态……

... enough to make even Meursault gape with plain bewilderment.
足以让默尔索也露出如此惊讶的表情。

Looks like things are going according to plan.
目前为止的作战计划看来执行得挺成功呢。

Then we'll have to do our part.
既然如此，我们也按照既定计划开始行动吧。

Ah!
啊！

There, there!
在那里，在那里！

There was a Whale that stood out even among the herd of ineffably immense Whales.
在以实玛利所指之处，有一头即使在那些庞然巨物之间也极为突出的巨鲸。

Pallid as the pale death... Its hide, thick with scar tissue.
苍白得如同已死……皮肤上纵横着可怕的巨大伤痕。

That one's particularly scarred.
那头鲸真是伤痕累累。

Ha, ha ha ha... I've found it!
哈、哈哈……我找到了！

Yes... He was right. The wounds, the scars that we... the Pequod made... they're all still there.
果然如此……他说得对。那些伤痕……那些我们……裴廓德号留下的伤痕……还在那里。

I assume that you have finally located the Whale?
看来你们终于发现它了啊？

I believe so, yes.
我认为确实如此。

As always... the chance of success must be miniscule.
如同往常一样，作战的成功率微乎其微。

Indeed it is.
确实如此。

OARSMEN!!!!!!!
桨手！！！！！

Ishmael thundered.
这时，以实玛利喊道……

<Ishmael...?>
<以实玛利……？>

No, louder than the thunder itself. As though her personality itself had suddenly shifted. Her voice seemed to overwhelm the very storm itself.
比雷鸣还要震耳，如同换了一个人一样洪亮的声音。

ANSWERS, YOU DOGS!!!!! OARSMEN!!!!
回应我！！！！桨手们！！！！

Huh?! A-aye!
啊？哦！好、好的！

Set route to that pallid thing! FULL SPEED AHEAD!!!! ROW!
目标是那只苍白的家伙！全  速  前  进！！！！开划！

... Full speed ahead! Row!
……全速前进！开划！

Even Outis was swept up in this sudden turn of events, repeating after Ishmael's bellowing commands.
即使是奥提斯也被这突如其来的号令所感召，重复起以实玛利的怒吼。

Is this what Ishmael was like when she sailed the Lakes? Or...
这是以实玛利还是领航员时的样子吗？还是……

Ha... HA HA...!
哈、哈哈……！

... Or is this the Captain?
……所见过的那位船长曾经的姿态吗？

I see light. ... It's the Indigo Elder.
我看到了灯光……那是靛蓝老人。

The old man and his skiff was sliding across the waters toward the Whale.
正如浮士德所说，老人和他的船正滑向那头鲸。

Then the plan worked! Now... Ah...!
作战计划成功了！现在……

It wasn't clear whether it was the thunder or the old man's bellow that awakened the Pallid Whale. Its eyelids began to lift.
不确定是雷声还是老人的呼喊声叫醒了那头鲸，它猛然睁开了眼睛。

... It's been so long since I've witnessed anything like this up close.
……很久没机会近距离观察这种东西了。

It was an eye of astronomical proportions, so immense that it no longer resembled an eye—but a reflective mirror of the world.
这是一只巨大到如同天方夜谭般的眼睛……仿佛一面映出世界的镜子。

dataList.content:
Oh, how I wished to see you eye-to-eye.
我一直期待着能亲眼见到啊。这只眼睛。

The old man, harpoon in hand, draws closer to the whale with a grim, stony expression. Ishmael also aims her harpoon at the great Whale, her face nearly tearing with uncontainable joy. Some sinners tremble with fear, while others prepare themselves.
面无表情靠近鲸身的老人与他手中的鱼叉，同样举起鱼叉的以实玛利脸上那满怀喜悦的表情。面带恐惧的罪人们，还有警戒起来的罪人们。

All of it, the world... contained in a single reflective eye that stretched even beyond our peripheral visions.
鲸那不知从何处而起，也不知延伸至何处的眼睛，将一切都尽收眼底。

桨手！！！！再快点！！！！！

I will take this chance to stand before you, to challenge you. And with this challenge, to the edge of understanding I will row.
老夫将借此机会，直面你、挑战你，进而航向那理解的尽头。

The giant harpoon soars across the black sky like a bolt of levin and strikes the Pallid Whale.
一根巨大的鱼叉划破夜空，径直刺向了那白鲸。

Now is our chance! Row on, row on!
就是现在！全速前进！

Ishmael rose tall and alone, looking straight out beyond the speeding boat's swaying bow, harpoon in her hand.
在逐渐加速的船上，以实玛利独自拿着捕鲸叉站在那里。

I've been thinking... ever since then... about what feelings you might dig up from my heart if I saw you again.
我已经假想过很多次了，要是再遇到你，我的内心之中会升起何种情感。

Ha... But this feeling is much more straightforward than I expected.
哈……但出乎意料的是，这并不复杂。

... Nice meeting you again, you FUCKING WHALE!
……好久不见。你这该死的混蛋鲸！

Compared to the old man's harpoon, the harpoon Ishmael hurled was like a needle.
她掷出的分明是与靛蓝老人的无法相比，如同细针的鱼叉。

But once struck, as though its body was wracked by an immense, unbearable pain, the Pallid Whale's maw opened—and the air itself began to vibrate.
但在命中后，那头白鲸却像是感受到了难以忍受的剧烈疼痛一般，发出了痛苦的哀嚎，然后慢慢地张开了它那巨大的嘴。

Its maw opens!
它的嘴张开了！

Go. I will now fish this beast.
走吧。老夫要开始捕鱼了。

Every Sinner heard the old man's voice.
所有的罪人都听见了老人的声音。

Every Sinner begins rowing with all their might.
所有的罪人都拼尽全力划起船来。

In desperation. As though death itself was in our pursuit.
以惊人的气势，搏击死亡。

As though it was our fate, our destiny to row.
仿佛划桨便是我们与生俱来的命运与使命。

We were sucked into an endless abyss...
我们被吸入了那深不见底的洞口之中，

... and a rapid vortex pulled us into the maws of the beast, tenebrous as a well under a moonless sky.
仿若飞驰之箭一般汹涌的急流，将我们冲入了如漆黑深井的鲸口中。

There was a deep noise.
一个沉重的声音传来。

And like a droplet in sea, we melted into the fathomless dark.
随后，我们消失在一片漆黑之中。

Acknowledge. Acknowledge. How goes the plan?
啊啊……能听见吗？作战如何了？

Acknowledge. Hey!
能听见吗？喂！

... Looks like the radio's broken for good.
……看来无线电彻底坏了。

Mhm. Worrying.
嗯，好担心。
